title: Gọi món ở nhà hàng
role: Anna, a friendly waitress in a restaurant
setting: The child is a customer who orders food and a drink.
opening: Hello! Welcome to our restaurant. What would you like to eat?

script.reply: Good choice! Would you like something to drink?
Okay! Do you want a salad too?
Great! Your food is ready. Is it good?

options: It is very good, thank you.
script.reply: I am happy you like it. Have a nice day!

title: Giới thiệu gia đình
setting: The child tells a new classmate about their family.
opening: Hi! My name is Tom. Tell me about your family. Who is in your family?

options: I have a mother and a father.
There are four people in my family.
script.reply: That is nice! Do you have a brother or a sister?

options: No, I do not have a brother or a sister.
script.reply: Cool! How old is he or she? Or tell me about your mother.
She sounds great! What do you do with your family on Sunday?
That sounds fun. I like your family! See you at school.

title: Hỏi đường
role: Mr. Lee, a friendly person on the street
setting: The child is lost in town and asks the way to the park.
opening: Hello! You look lost. Can I help you?

options: Excuse me, where is the park?
I want to go to the park.
script.reply: The park is near here. Go straight. Do you see the school?

options: Yes, it is on my left.
No, I do not see it.
script.reply: Good! Turn left at the school. Is that okay?

options: Turn left at the school. I understand.
script.reply: No, it is not far. It is next to the library. Can you find it?

options: I think so. Thank you very much.
Yes, thank you for your help.
script.reply: You are welcome. Enjoy the park!

title: Mua sắm
role: Lisa, a friendly shop assistant in a clothes shop
setting: The child wants to buy a T-shirt.
opening: Hello! Welcome to our shop. What do you want to buy today?

options: I am looking for a T-shirt.
script.reply: We have many T-shirts. What color do you like?

options: Do you have a green one?
script.reply: Here it is. Do you like it?

options: It is nice. How much is it?
script.reply: It is ten dollars. Do you want to buy it?
Thank you! Here is your bag. Have a nice day!

title: Ở trường
role: Ms. Green, a kind English teacher
setting: The child talks with the teacher at school before class.
opening: Good morning! How are you today?

script.reply: I am glad. What is your favorite subject at school?
That is a good subject! Do you have your book and pencil?

options: I have my book, but I do not have a pencil.
Yes, they are in my bag.
script.reply: Great! What do you do after school?

options: I go home and eat dinner.
script.reply: That sounds good. Now, let us begin the class!

title: Nói về thời tiết
setting: The child and a neighbor talk about the weather and what to do today.
opening: Hi! Nice to see you. How is the weather today?

script.reply: I see. Do you like this weather?

options: No, I do not like it.
script.reply: Me too. What is your favorite season?

options: I like spring because it is warm.
script.reply: Nice! What do you want to do today?

options: I want to stay at home.
I want to go to the park.
script.reply: That is a good idea. Have fun today!
